description: Source code implementing FIS table updating functions for MTD, including functions for opening, validating, and remapping FIS partitions, with structures defining FIS image headers and CRCs.

methods.name: fis_close
methods.description: Closes the FIS descriptor, unmapping memory and closing file descriptor.

methods.name: fis_open
methods.description: Opens the FIS directory, mapping it into memory.

methods.name: fis_validate
methods.description: Validates the presence of old partitions in the FIS directory.

methods.name: fis_remap
methods.description: Remaps and updates the FIS table with new partition information.
